description: Strong and weak ownership with atomic and non-atomic counts

expected.contract: Downgrade, retain, drop, drop yields strong0,weak1, one value destruction and no control reclamation. Upgrade now fails DEAD. Dropping the remaining weak reclaims the control once. Four threads each retain/drop5000 times while holding their own strong reference; after all owned strong references end, destruction occurs once, and a retained weak keeps the control available for a failed upgrade.

verification_method: Independent state/set oracle recomputes cases.json; prose and changed conditions are assessed separately.
